reason: Preserve the original matched-time benchmark and test whether sparse common blocks retain useful power with substantially fewer readouts
inherited: All observation, calibration, initialization and confidence assumptions from the parent contract; only common block durations and deterministic quotas change

design.allocation: Pay the inherited initial gap once; retain equal fixed quotas floor((budget-burn)/(2H)); all lag1 blocks followed by all lag2 blocks
design.baseline: Original H2 counts and optimized old-gap results remain in dependence.json unchanged
design.selection: The entire menu is frozen before new samples. These results do not authorize postselected use of a single-contrast bound on the same records

analytic_design.cost_definition: C=T+zeta*R after dividing by constant waiting power times the lag1 time unit; R counts individual endpoint readouts, and zeta is readout energy divided by that unit waiting energy
analytic_design.scope: Hypothetical parametric resource accounting. Waiting power, readout energy and detector duration are not measured. Optimize only over the declared finite block grid, with every detector record counted. External calibration costs remain separate.

reported_metrics: all frozen-menu power and coverage values
finite-grid normalized-cost optimum and selection scope
claim_limit: No guarantee of uniformly greater power, no calibrated energy advantage, and no mixing envelope learned from the tested records
